subject: Renewal closeout & collections playbook — Greenleaf Health
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Marco Sanz <marco.sanz@greenleaf.health>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Jan 2028 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Renewal closeout & collections playbook — Greenleaf Health

Marco — looping you in to finalize the end-of-term true-up and invoice handoff for your upcoming renewal. We’ve run the usage reconciliation and have a single final invoice covering Oct–Dec 2027 consumptions plus the committed renewal payment.

Key asks: please confirm preferred payment path (wire vs. ACH) and whether AP needs a consolidated PDF invoice or separate line-item CSV for accounting ingestion. Also, we need the VAT certificate on file to process the EU line items (if applicable).

I’ve attached the draft final invoice and VAT extract for your review. Suggested next steps:
- You confirm payment method and PO/contract reference (by EOD Mon 1/16)
- If wire, provide beneficiary name and SWIFT; if ACH, provide banking details and ACH remit instructions
- We’ll schedule a short 15-min collection call on Tue (1/17) to confirm acceptance and ETA for payment

Thanks — we want to avoid delaying the Jan 31 cutoff for revenue recognition.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Revenue Ops Manager
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Greenleaf_Final_Invoice_2028-01.pdf (PDF, 240 KB)]
[Attachment: Greenleaf_VAT_Certificate_2028.pdf (PDF, 85 KB)]

From: Marco Sanz <marco.sanz@greenleaf.health>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Accounts Payable <ap@greenleaf.health>
Date: Thu, 12 Jan 2028 12:04:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Renewal closeout & collections playbook — Greenleaf Health

Thanks Naomi — got the documents. A few quick clarifying questions for AP (cc’d):
1) Can you split the invoice into ‘Usage’ and ‘Renewal commitment’ lines? Our ERP prefers separate GL codes.
2) For the VAT certificate: the copy you sent looks like the supplier-side doc. Do you also have Redwood’s VAT registration number for cross-checking?
3) Proposed payment: wire to be scheduled the week of 1/23. Can you confirm the beneficiary details?

I'll have AP confirm the PO reference and whether they need the CSV.

—Marco
Finance Lead, Greenleaf Health

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>

Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Jan 2028 14:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal closeout & collections playbook — Greenleaf Health

Marco — thanks for the quick read. We can publish a two-line invoice (Usage / Renewal) and also export a CSV with the usage detail for your GL system. I attached the split draft and included Redwood's VAT registration in the footer.

A couple of notes:
- Beneficiary (wire): Redwood Inference, Inc.
- Bank: First Pacific Bank
- SWIFT: FPACUS33
- Account: 987654321
- Reference: GL-2028-RNWL-023 / PO-# (please confirm PO number)

Vanessa

Subject: Re: Renewal closeout & collections playbook — Greenleaf Health

Vanessa / Naomi — AP here. We can do wire. Confirming the PO: GL-PO-4876. We prefer the CSV file for ingestion (date/usage_tokens/line_description/amount). Will release payment on receipt and confirmation of bank details.

Also, please include Redwood’s VAT registration number in the invoice header (our system validates that field). We have the company remittance contact as ap@greenleaf.health for the remittance advice.

Thanks,
Marta Alvarez
Accounts Payable, Greenleaf Health

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>

Date: Mon, 16 Jan 2028 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal closeout & collections playbook — Greenleaf Health

Hi Marta — thanks. Attached is the usage CSV export and a confirmed two-line invoice PDF that includes Redwood's VAT registration (VAT-ID: US123456789). Bank details are as Vanessa listed above.

Quick checklist we followed for the handoff: 
- Invoice split: Usage / Renewal commitment (attached PDF)
- CSV: rows include service_date, sku, usage_tokens, unit_price, amount (attached)
- VAT: Redwood VAT-ID in header and separate certificate attached to the thread
- Payment reference: GL-2028-RNWL-023 / GL-PO-4876

Please let us know after the wire has been initiated so we can mark the renewal as paid in our systems. If there are any remittance file requirements, we can accept a copy at ap@redwood.com.

Regards,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Revenue Analyst
Redwood Inference
